name: leave-tracker
description: GH-600 loop engineering demo: React web app + API + MCP server.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w api" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w api && npm run build -w mcp
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w api && npm run typecheck -w web && npm run typecheck -w mcp
